rendered_body: 手机前置或后摄。人物自然收尾，平静而有感染力地说英文 CTA，例如：Grab this for your energy levels at the link below — your your energy levels will thank you! Don't wait another sluggish week goes by. 无补光灯，无美颜，人物面部没有高光，真实皮肤纹理和瑕疵。
